title: Is the 1993-2020 temperature record homogeneous in time
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), test whether the record is homogeneous in time. Look for step changes, changes in variance and other signs that the reanalysis changed character when the observations it assimilates changed, determine when and where such changes occur and how you tell them from real ocean variability, and estimate how much they could bias a trend or a count of extreme days computed from this record.
